name: geonames
description: GeoNames (geonames.org) is an open world gazetteer with about 13M places. This CLI searches places and postal codes and reads place details, edit history, metro areas, the admin hierarchy (geotree), country data, largest cities, highest mountains, admin divisions, feature statistics, recent edits and site totals.

commands.name: search-places
commands.summary: Search places worldwide by keyword (name, alternate name, ...). Returns matching features with ids, country, feature type, population and coordinates.

params.name: q
params.description: Search term: place name, alternate name, airport code, etc.

commands.name: get-place
commands.summary: Get the detail page facts for a place by geonameId: coordinates, population, elevation, timezone, feature code, Wikipedia link and the ancestor hierarchy.

params.name: geonameId
params.description: GeoNames feature id (the 'id' from search-places)

params.name: slug
params.description: Lowercase ASCII URL slug of the place name, as in the 'url' from search-places (e.g. 'zuerich' for Zürich)

commands.name: get-place-history
commands.summary: List the edit history (revisions, user, comment, time) of a place by geonameId.

params.name: geonameId
params.description: GeoNames feature id

commands.name: get-metropolitan-area
commands.summary: Get the metropolitan area(s) a city belongs to or is the center of: the center city, the role and the number of areas.

params.name: geonameId
params.description: GeoNames id of a city

commands.name: list-place-subdivision-regions
commands.summary: List the sub-division map regions (e.g. city districts) inside a place, with ids and names. Only exists for places that have subdivisions.

params.name: geonameId
params.description: GeoNames id of the parent place (country, admin division or city)

commands.name: get-geotree-path
commands.summary: Get the ancestor path from Earth down to a feature in the administrative geotree.

params.name: id
params.description: GeoNames feature id

commands.name: list-geotree-children
commands.summary: List the children of a feature in the geotree, e.g. the countries of a continent or the admin divisions of a country. Paginated.

params.name: parentId
params.description: GeoNames id of the parent (6295630 = Earth, 6255148 = Europe, country ids, ...)

params.name: startRow
params.description: Offset of the first child to return

params.name: maxRows
params.description: Page size

commands.name: search-postal-codes
commands.summary: Search postal codes by code or place name, optionally limited to one country.

params.name: q
params.description: Postal code (e.g. 8001) or place name

params.name: country
params.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code to restrict the search, e.g. CH

params.name: maxRows
params.description: Maximum number of results

commands.name: get-postal-code
commands.summary: Get the full record of a postal code by postalCodeId: admin hierarchy with geoname ids, timezone, coordinates and accuracy.

params.name: postalCodeId
params.description: Internal postal code id (postalCodeId from search-postal-codes)

commands.name: get-postal-code-shape
commands.summary: Get the boundary polygon of a postal code area as GeoJSON geometry.

params.name: postalCodeId
params.description: Internal postal code id

commands.name: list-countries
commands.summary: List all countries with ISO codes, capital, area, population, continent, currency, languages, neighbours, postal code format and geonameId.

commands.name: list-largest-cities
commands.summary: List the largest cities of a country by population.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. CH

commands.name: list-highest-mountains
commands.summary: List the highest mountains of a country; value is the elevation in meters.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. CH

commands.name: list-admin-divisions
commands.summary: List the first-level administrative divisions (ISO-3166-2 subdivisions) of a country with codes, type, capital and population (in the row text).

params.name: country
params.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, e.g. CH

params.name: countrySlug
params.description: Lowercase hyphenated English country name, e.g. switzerland, united-states

commands.name: get-country-feature-statistics
commands.summary: Count a country's features by feature class and code (ADM3, LK, PPL, ...). The row text holds count, code, name and description.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, e.g. CH

commands.name: list-recent-changes
commands.summary: List the latest edits to the gazetteer: revision, time, place, country, user, feature code and change comment.

commands.name: get-gazetteer-stats
commands.summary: Get site-wide totals: feature count, features and postal codes per country, the last 7 days of edit activity and the most recent edits.

commands.name: list-timezones
commands.summary: List the timezones known to GeoNames with their country code.

commands.name: list-oceans-and-seas
commands.summary: List the world's oceans and seas (132) with their geonameIds.

notes: Ids chain between commands. search-places returns 'id', which is the geonameId for get-place, get-place-history, get-metropolitan-area and get-geotree-path. search-postal-codes returns 'postalCodeId' for the get-postal-code* commands.

Values in search-places results are mostly strings (e.g. population "415367", lat "47.36667"). Field names are abbreviated: cn = country name, cc = country code, fc/fcn = feature class/name, admnN = admin names.
get-place needs the URL slug. Take it from the 'url' field of search-places, e.g. https://www.geonames.org/2657896/zuerich.html → slug 'zuerich'.
Country commands take ISO alpha-2 codes (CH, US, DE). list-admin-divisions also needs the lowercase hyphenated English country name as slug.
In list-admin-divisions, get-country-feature-statistics and list-recent-changes, the header row and group/total rows may show up as items with empty fields. Skip them.
get-postal-code-history often returns an empty array.
Writes (e.g. adding an alternate name) need a signed-in account and were not captured, so they are not supported.
The documented public web-service API at api.geonames.org needs a username parameter and is not covered here. These commands use the site's own unauthenticated /api endpoints.
